processSpec.calibrationRule: Cross-domain metaphor remaps (Condensation≈ink bleed, Lensing≈press halo) are semantic analogies, not unit-preserving transforms: unitProvenance=illustrative, calibration=not-claimed, explicit print units (mm, um, gsm, ms). Never inherit calibrated from optical nm/IOR fits or spec-only Living Cloth formulas (Consumer Spec v1.3 §1).
processSpec.progressSemanticsNote: t∈[0,1] scrubs an authored plate-press cycle; it does not claim physical un-bleed. Capillary dwell within a single live press gesture is monotonic (hysteresis).

gloss.idle: plate at rest; dry ink film

gloss.impressed: plate bite / deboss under impression travel

idle.description: clean plate, flat ink, no halo

lensing.description: static soft press-halo outline at rest offset; no animated catch-light

drifting.description: two-layer riso print at default misregistration_dx/dy_mm, no motion

transitions.note: plate-state-scrub maps t to authored cycle idle→lensing→impressed→bleeding→drifting
